title: Return of seized documents
description: Return of seized or produced documents, records or articles

steps.step: Seizure or production of documents, records or articles under clause (a) or (c) of sub-section (1)
Taking of copies or extracts of the seized or produced documents, records or articles
Certification of the copies or extracts by the person from whom they were seized or who produced them
Return of the seized or produced documents, records or articles to the person from whom they were seized or who produced them within twenty days of seizure or production
